title: Pizza Party: A Command Line Program for Ordering Pizza
summary: A short 2007 demo of Pizza Party, a command line program that orders Domino's pizza from a UNIX-like terminal. The video shows the designers placing an order using the software.
why: Cited as a nostalgic example of a CLI that orders pizza whenever HN discusses terminal-based ordering.

quote.text: reminds me a little of the old-school Pizza Party terminal app from the '90s
